items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: you're not talking to me, Poesie, you want me to explain to you?

ctx.x: Go ahead, any time. Just tell us about when you were born.

Yeah, sure. I was born in Louisiana, yeah. I was born on Boilbun, between Scalmers and Cornelius. Oh, yes. And what year was that? 1817. I got my birthday if I can get it. 18... 17. Yes. And your birthday is, when will it be? On the 25th of Monday, 25th of this month. I was born in March. 87 years ago. 87 years ago. No, sir. I'm 87. Me, oh. Yes, that's what I mean. Yeah, that's what you mean. And what was the first kind of music you remember hearing around? Huh? What was the first kind of music you remember…
